We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE CONSUMER BUSINESS SERVICES TEAM

 - Sierra partners with the businesses that power everyday life for consumers and enterprises alike — from the CPG brands on every shelf to the logistics networks that get products there, the real estate and facilities teams that manage the buildings people live and work in, and the energy and utility providers that keep the lights on. Our agents handle everything from order tracking and account management to field service scheduling and billing support, tuned to the voice and workflows of each business.

 - This vertical spans a wide range of industries — consumer products, commercial real estate, automotive & mobility, transportation & logistics, industrial manufacturing, information & data services, consumer electronics, professional services, facilities management, construction, energy, and utilities — giving you the breadth to build relationships across some of the largest and most established companies in the world.

 - Join us to bring AI agents to the businesses that quietly run the economy — and help build technology that makes these essential services faster, more reliable, and more human for everyone who depends on them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Work directly with our Sales, Product and Agent Engineering teams to both drive our GTM function, as well as continuously improve our Agents through our customer-driven product development philosophy

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work

 - 3-4+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $200-$500k

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - A track record of handling a high number of deals concurrently without cutting quality, and comfortable switching between sub-industries and use cases

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
